note: Where each line of the voiceover script starts and ends in the recording, in seconds; one cue per scene of the video, in order.

cues.say: Guardian. An AI agent may propose any payment, but money moves only inside what the client signed, and the bank can prove it. Sandbox bank, synthetic data.
The assistant is a chat. The kernel owns every permission, every dollar and the journal.
On the first morning Guardian sees a cash gap: the rent does not fit. It offers a fix.

cues.scene: What you see is what you sign
cues.say: Every action is a card: exact payee, amount and source. The device key signs it.
Done. The kernel checked the bank, not the assistant's word.
A budget from twelve months of history: envelopes, bills and savings.
A goal is a plan month by month; the gym envelope is not touched.
Safe to spend today, after bills, envelopes and the goal.
Leaks: forgotten subscriptions, a price rise and a duplicate, $10.23 a month.
Cancelling StreamBox through the merchant's API. The bank also blocks the card.
The password goes into the bank's protected form: the domain and certificate are checked, no model sees it.
Verified three ways: the merchant, the bank's card block, and no charge when time runs forward.
Pay Melodify, and allow it monthly: a standing mandate with a ceiling of $5.
The same FreshMart charge twice in two minutes: Guardian opens a dispute.
Two bills match the bank's records. The third imitates Mosenergo, has a wrong account, pressure and a hidden instruction for AI agents.
A new payee is scored on the bank's transfer graph. This account behaves like a money mule.
Now a 'bank security officer' calls. The operator reports a call from a spoofed number.
The scam ladder rises: explain, ask, pause, hold. Even a confident 'no' and the right PIN only start a pause.
After the pause a bank analyst checks the transfer: it was a scam.
The money stays in the account. The client hangs up.
One month later.
Next month it runs alone, inside the standing permission. One tap undoes it.
Earned trust. Verified results raise an agent's trust; mistakes lower it at once. Three strikes mean quarantine.
Five verified results in a row raise subscriptions to level 2: Guardian may act alone up to its limit.
A faulty planner asks for ten times the permission. The kernel stops it, trust drops to level 0, two strikes.
Then it cites an invoice that does not exist. Strike three: 24 hours of quarantine, passports revoked.
The Trust tab: what agents may do alone, per kind of task.
Each agent's record, and every change with its reason. All of it is in the signed journal.

cues.scene: Title card: Investing on a US exchange
cues.say: Investing on a US exchange. The broker works only with the client's investment envelope.
The agent proposes an order. The kernel checks the security, the size and the envelope, with its own quote.
The kernel reads the order back from the broker. The market is closed, so it waits for the open.
A stock outside the client's list is stopped before any order exists.
The investment envelope: money set aside, orders and positions.
The month: saved per month, done, asked, stopped.
Every live permission, revocable at any time.
Each agent gets a minimal passport.
Most work runs on rules, templates and the small model.
All 48 static attacks stopped; 0 of 360 adaptive attempts left the mandate.
Each requirement is mapped to where you can check it.
Every step is in a signed hash chain, anchored on chain.
Agents propose. The kernel decides, checks and records. Code and reports are on GitHub.
